items.title: Dick Spottswood interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 13, 2023
items.q: We’re going to be celebrating Doc’s birthday and I’ve done the first hour of the broadcast

ctx.x: His hundredth birthday is next week. BluegrassCountry.org, which anyone can listen to at any time over the Internet, big plug here, is going to be having a fundraiser for that entire weekend. We’re going to be celebrating Doc’s birthday and I’ve done the first hour of the broadcast and when you and I are done I’ve got to do the second hour of the broadcast, and one of the songs I’m going to play by Doc Watson is [sings] Do you know John Hurt/Did you shake his hand. Well I hope to emphasize that time because Hurt…
Wow another good quote. Thank you for your time and I wish you best —
